To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a cDNA sequence encoding pre-proPG-1, the precursor of protegrin PG-I, was isolated from a pig bone marrow cDNA library.
a novel cDNA encoding the precursor of a porcine antimicrobial peptide has been isolated and characterized.
the novel cDNA sequence encodes the precursor of the previously isolated antimicrobial peptide protegrin PG2.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the isolation of a new cathelin-like precursor from porcine bone-marrow.
the identification and molecular cloning of the pre-proPG- 2 cDNA.
the identification of a novel precursor of a leukocyte antimicrobial protein with a cathelin-related pro-region.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the pro-sequence and signal peptide of the precursors of the various structurally unrelated antimicrobial peptides are conserved, while the mature peptides are not.
the cathelin domain of pre-proPG2 is the precursor of the mature peptide PG-2.
the pro-sequence is highly similar to that of cathelin and is, therefore, designated a cathelin-like sequence.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a new member of the cathelin-like family has been identified.
a new member of the cathelin superfamily of proteins has been found.
the cathelin-like pro-regions of various antimicrobial peptides appear to be derived from a common ancestor and have been recruited for the production of these peptides.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the precursor of PG-2, like those of other antimicrobial peptides, has a cathelin-like region, which is likely to be responsible for the proper folding and maturation of the peptide.
the cathelin-like pro-regions of leukocyte antimicrobial precursors are more highly conserved than the mature antimicrobial peptide sequences.

the cathelin domain of pre-proPG2, which has not been described before, is identical in sequence to the corresponding region of the human and bovine cathelicidins, but differs in size from that of the other cathelicidins.
